primary_source_record.limitation: Not immutable lineage, restartability, ChemSmart correctness, performance, reproducibility outcomes, physical validity, or SOTA evidence.

supported: The publisher version-of-record has the specified page and section locators.
The current Crossref update-to field is a limited metadata observation.
